thread:
Ben: Heads-up — FinBank is asking for a contract-grade SLA. 99.99% uptime, p95 < 50ms for text-gen, dedicated capacity, 24/7 premium support. They want initial SLA language by EOW. Looping in product for triage.

Alice: Thanks Ben. Can you confirm expected QPS, regions, ARR, and whether they require multi-region active-active? Need those to prioritize.

Fadi: FinBank expects ~150 qps peak, mostly NA+EU, ramp to 300 qps over 6 months. Committed ARR ~ $1.2M. Deadline for LOI/EOW.

Carmen: Support note — we had 3 infra incidents last quarter affecting hosted autoscaler; typical outage 8–12m. Repro and incident links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2025-45

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-45 created by Carmen at 2025-11-07T14:22:11Z

Devon: 99.99% (≈4.3m/mo) is achievable but only with Dedicated + cross-region failover + warm caches. Need to lock which models are in-scope (large decoder vs quantized variants) and token throughput caps. Cost impact likely +35–60% infra for reserved capacity and redundancy.

Ellen: From legal — we'll need exact measurement methodology, credit formula, maintenance window policy, and termination triggers. Also clarify whether we guarantee latency per-request or per-route.

Alice: Proposed immediate next steps (owners):
1) Draft SLO proposal (Alice)
2) Eng feasibility & cost delta (Devon)
3) Support runbook & escalation matrix (Carmen)
4) Legal SLA text & penalties (Ellen)
5) Sales confirm customer acceptance and payment terms (Ben/Fadi)

Alice: Draft SLO (very rough):
```
SLO: 99.95% monthly uptime (default)
SLA Commitment (proposed for Dedicated tier): 99.99% monthly uptime measured on rolling 30d window
Latency: p95 < 50ms for approved model subset under agreed QPS cap
Measurement: synthetic probes + production telemetry; exclusions: scheduled maintenance with 72h notice
Credits: proportional to downtime minutes beyond SLA threshold, capped at X% of monthly fee
```

Devon: Feasibility quick notes — active-active with regional TGs + health checks, persistent KV cache warmup, and pre-warmed model shards needed. Warm-up window ~10–15m; cold-starts can violate p95 if we don't limit model subset. Implementation estimate: 2–3 sprints to prototype, +1 sprint for hardening.

Carmen: I'll prepare the runbook skeleton and add observability checks (synthetic pings, error-rate alerts, cost per token dashboard) and an escalation matrix: Tier1 on-call -> Dedicated account oncall -> Eng-srv rotation.

Ben: Customer will pay for premium support and dedicated pool if we can commit to 99.99 + 2hr incident response SLA. They want to sign quickly.

Alice: OK — I'll schedule a 30m triage call tomorrow 10am PT and circulate an intake doc. Who's up for a fast-track? React with :thumbsup: if yes.

Devon: :thumbsup:
Carmen: :thumbsup:
Fadi: :thumbsup:
Ellen: I'll review but need legal doc first :eyes:

Alice: Thanks — I'll own coordination. I'll post the intake doc and JIRA ticket after the call.
